about.title: / About Me
about.p1: I am a Frontend Developer and Data Analyst with a solid track record in high-demand corporate environments like PwC Argentina and Grupo Sancor Seguros. My differential value lies in combining business logic and process management with modern software development.
about.p2: What do I bring to your team?
about.bullet1: 🚀 Hybrid Vision: I don't just write code; I understand the impact of software on operational and financial processes.
about.bullet2: 📈 Real Results: I have led optimizations that reduced operational times by 20% and administrative flows by 30%.
about.bullet3: 🧠 Innovation: Certified in Microsoft and SAP technologies, I integrate AI and data analysis to create smart and efficient user experiences.
about.stack_frontend: 💻 Frontend: React, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, UX/UI, Responsive Design.
about.stack_data: 📊 Data & AI: Power BI, Azure AI Studio, Data Analysis.
about.stack_tools: ⚙️ Tools: Git, GitHub, Agile Methodologies, SAP, Microsoft Copilot.
about.goal: I seek to join teams that value technological innovation to generate real business impact.

jobs.description: Provided support to US clients on tax compliance (Form K1) and account management, ensuring high standards of regulatory accuracy. Reduced average response times by 20% by optimizing workflows, maintaining a 95% Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score. Managed data quality in CRM to ensure metric compliance and a consistent user experience.

Managed the comprehensive evaluation of claims, coordinating with adjusters and applying technical and legal criteria for effective claim resolution. Led document management and digitization initiatives, ensuring efficient organization of files and inventories, facilitating the transition to paperless processes. Monitored payments to vendors and performed billing audits, optimizing financial processes and reducing administrative time.

Managed legal documentation and drafted certifications, ensuring strict compliance with banking and regulatory standards. Guaranteed the proper processing of procedures with a high level of accuracy and confidentiality.
Provided legal-administrative support for judicial files and organized complex legal documentation. Collaborated with legal teams to ensure compliance with current regulatory frameworks.

items.description: Intensive training in software development focusing on programming, databases, web architecture, UX/UI, and agile methodologies. The program centered on building scalable digital solutions with a focus on usability, design, and complex problem-solving.
Practical specialization in designing and building modern websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Main focus on usability, user experience (UX), and responsive design.
Studies focused on graphic design, visual communication, applied creativity, and audiovisual production. Training strengthened aesthetic, conceptual, and technical vision within digital environments.
